metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct Maven project setup session skill with no semantic overlap to existing skills. Existing skills are Next.js/JavaScript-focused (bundle analysis, static asset serving); candidate addresses Maven POM configuration, directory structure, and build profiles—a different technology domain and task family. Peer candidates (Maven community onboarding, multi-repository configuration, third-party JAR installation) are related but address different workflows; this candidate is the foundational project initialization skill that precedes or complements them.
